_comment: Merged into the image's MANAGED settings (/etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json) at build, on top of the upstream base (hooks, MCP allowlist, no bypass mode, git commit/push grants). Arrays are unioned; keys starting with _ are dropped. Put site grants here, e.g. an exact-command Bash allow for a committed helper script, so they are human-merged image changes the agent cannot override. An MCP server the site adds needs its launcher in allowedMcpServers ({"serverCommand": ["/path"]}). Set allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly: true to ignore permission rules from the workspace (DESIGN.md §4.5). Tool-call telemetry (opt-in, docs/AUDIT.md): an "env" with OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT turns it on in managed settings, tool parameters only.
